result.description: Spend management platform: corporate cards, business banking, expenses, bill pay and travel for companies.
result.auth_detail: User token (bearer) generated by account/card admin in dashboard for own account. OAuth2 authorization-code for partner apps acting on other Brex accounts; client ID/secret issued by Brex developer support. Onboarding API uses client credentials.
result.access_detail: User token is self-serve but needs an existing Brex customer account with admin role and acceptance of the developer API agreement. Multi-tenant OAuth needs partner credentials issued by Brex (via developer support), so not open signup. Partner-auth page was 404 on fetch, so this is from search snippets, lower confidence.
result.api_notes: REST at https://api.brex.com. Reference sections include Team (users, cards, departments, locations), Transactions (card and cash transactions, statements), Payments (transfers, vendors), plus Onboarding, Webhooks, Budgets and Expenses per search results. Only settled transactions are returned; receiving payments (ACH debit) is not supported.
result.blocker: Multi-tenant OAuth requires Brex-issued partner client credentials via developer support. Otherwise per-customer admin-created user tokens (API key style) work today.

evidence.quote: The user token is used to authenticate your own Brex account.
The OAuth token is used when building partner applications to authenticate other Brex accounts.
generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.
